2115776735463563746.en_summary: @KobeissiLetter reports, citing Bloomberg, that Microsoft $MSFT is launching a 10-part high-grade bond offering for the first time since 2017 to help fund its massive AI investments. Maturities range from 2 to 40 years, with proceeds for general corporate purposes including capital expenditures. He says AI-related borrowing continues to surge.
2115776735463563746.zh_summary: @KobeissiLetter 引述彭博報道，微軟 $MSFT 自 2017 年以來首次推出分 10 批的高評級債券發行，以支持其龐大的 AI 投資。債券年期由 2 年至 40 年不等，所得款項用於一般企業用途，包括資本開支。他表示與 AI 相關的借貸持續激增。

2115777584726438060.en_summary: @Jake__Wujastyk asks whether $GOOGL just started a much larger market wide selloff in November, tagging $SPY and $QQQ.
2115777584726438060.zh_summary: @Jake__Wujastyk 提問 $GOOGL 是否剛剛引發了 11 月更大規模的全市場拋售，並標註 $SPY 與 $QQQ。

2115777779203821814.en_summary: @TheTranscript_ quotes the Mastercard CEO calling it another strong quarter with net revenue growth of 14%. Revenue rose 14% to $9.8B, operating margin went from 58.8% to 59.8%, operating income rose 16% to $5.9B and net income rose 18% to $4.6B. $MA is up 2% pre-market. An image is attached.
2115777779203821814.zh_summary: @TheTranscript_ 引述萬事達卡執行長表示本季又是強勁的一季，淨收入增長 14%。收入增長 14% 至 98 億美元，營業利潤率由 58.8% 升至 59.8%，營業利潤增長 16% 至 59 億美元，淨利潤增長 18% 至 46 億美元。$MA 盤前上漲 2%。附上圖片。

2115777992823869473.en_summary: @TrendSpider posts $MA Q3 earnings: adjusted EPS of $5.31 vs $5.16 estimated and sales of $9.807B vs $9.653B estimated, both beats. An image is attached.
2115777992823869473.zh_summary: @TrendSpider 公布 $MA 第三季業績：經調整每股盈利 5.31 美元，預期 5.16 美元；營收 98.07 億美元，預期 96.53 億美元，兩者均超出預期。附上圖片。

2115778907245007127.en_summary: @TheTranscript_ quotes the Caterpillar CEO saying Q3 results reflect the durability of its end markets, with strong order rates and a record backlog. Revenue rose 17% to $20.7B, operating margin went from 17.3% to 20.4% and EPS rose 46% to $7.13. $CAT is down 10% pre-market. An image is attached.
2115778907245007127.zh_summary: @TheTranscript_ 引述開拓重工執行長表示，第三季業績反映終端市場的韌性，訂單強勁，訂單積壓創紀錄。收入增長 17% 至 207 億美元，營業利潤率由 17.3% 升至 20.4%，每股盈利增長 46% 至 7.13 美元。$CAT 盤前下跌 10%。附上圖片。
